name: range-0
spec: op-private-interop/docs/DESIGN.md: the claim is an ordinary L2 transaction, and it leads the range it describes.
description: The first claim a chain ever emits: it describes range 0 (blocks 1..300) and is the leading user transaction of block 1. Present to show there is NO genesis edge — a claim leads the range it describes, so the first range opens exactly like every later one, with no parent field and no zero-hash special case to handle.
